settings.title: Six homes on the market now

settings.editor: Each one has been visited, measured and photographed by a partner. Telephone to arrange a viewing, or ask on the page of the home.
About one home in five is sold before it is advertised. Tell us what you are looking for and we will telephone first.

settings.title: Thinking of selling? Start with what it is worth.

settings.editor: A partner visits, looks properly and tells you a figure we would be happy to be held to. It takes an hour and costs nothing.
